single_required_correction.problem: An all973-parameter residual threshold can be dominated by819 private-gradient coordinates and hide a material relative mismatch in the154 shared coordinates where projection is applied.
single_required_correction.fixed_resolution: Keep the original full-vector parity check and additionally require shared-local parity <=r*(norm(gP_shared)+norm(gA_shared)) for every probe. Both full and shared zero-scale cases require exact equality. Assemble the split control in the original gradient dtype and order before converting it to float64 for residual, norm and dot audits.
single_required_correction.failure_behavior: Any of the24 full or shared parity failures is needs_numerical_review. Do not widen r, alter probes or label the mismatch harmless rounding.

numerical_assessment.verdict: Acceptable as a fixed, preregistered engineering-resolution screen for these computed gradient vectors. It is not a rigorous error bound on the upstream true gradient.
numerical_assessment.dot_screen: tau_dot=(gamma(2*d)+2*r+r*r)*norm(gP)*norm(gA), using the declared dimension d for each reported dot and float64 accumulation.
numerical_assessment.gamma_scope: The gamma term concerns rounding in the small float64 dot-product computation under its floating-point assumptions. It does not bound the forward/autograd/GEMM computations that produced gP or gA.
numerical_assessment.perturbation_scope: The2r+r*r term is a conditional perturbation budget if each input vector has relative perturbation at most r. Neither full nor shared split-backward parity proves that assumption or certifies the sign of an exact real-valued autograd gradient.
numerical_assessment.projection_displacement: Compare the actual after-cast displacement to the unchanged r*(norm(gP_shared)+norm(gA_shared)) screen. Retain raw negative dots and strict projection behavior even when their classification is numerically unresolved; the screen must not become an angle threshold in the algorithm.
numerical_assessment.nonfinite_or_unsupported_case: Stop at the concrete numerical/backend problem. Preserve zero-norm and cast information; no optimizer or tolerance reconstruction is authorized.
numerical_assessment.allowed_claim_after_passing: The specified asymmetric projection produced or did not produce a change resolvable under this fixed screen at the declared anchors/draws.
forbidden_claims: A rigorous bound on all upstream differentiation error.
Proof of negative transfer, training-trajectory conflict frequency or generalization benefit.
Proof that an actual AdamW step protects either the composite primary loss or allocation loss.
Trading efficacy, net SOXX excess, promotion or Goal completion.

mechanism_assessment.approved_rule: One projection of auxiliary shared gradient against the fixed composite primary shared gradient. Keep aligned and orthogonal auxiliary components; remove only the negative primary-direction component. Return the original auxiliary tensor unchanged for no conflict or zero primary norm.
mechanism_assessment.primary_objective: P is the unchanged original allocation objective plus0.02 times both primary BCE terms; A is the original0.05 weighted auxiliary BCE objective. No loss decomposition, relabeling or weight search is authorized.
mechanism_assessment.private_gradient: The pre-clip private vector is copied unchanged from the split control. A changed global clip coefficient may scale it differently afterward; this must be reported rather than called private-update invariance.
mechanism_assessment.exact_arithmetic_limit: For nonzero shared gP, exact Euclidean projection gives dot(gP,gP+gA_projected)>=norm(gP)^2. A positive global clip factor preserves that sign, not the same magnitude. The full primary vector additionally contains its unchanged private component.
mechanism_assessment.allocation_boundary: Composite P protection does not imply an allocation-only directional improvement. Report both P and allocation-only dots, shared and full, before and after clipping as specified.
mechanism_assessment.optimizer_boundary: No AdamW step is executed. Momentum, coordinatewise preconditioning and decoupled weight decay can change the actual update direction, and unsaved optimizer states must not be inferred, zero-filled or rebuilt.
mechanism_assessment.prior_evidence: The previously reported positive near-orthogonal all-auxiliary encoder cosines do not establish a negative-transfer mechanism and do not replace the24 fixed sampled probes.
